description: This source file implements an automated script for interacting with a web-based API of an Open WebUI project. It performs authentication, retrieves available models, selects a specific model, sends a prompt as a chat message, and verifies that the response contains a specific nonce value. The script relies heavily on environment variables for configuration and makes multiple API calls, handling responses and errors appropriately.

methods.name: getCookieHeader
methods.description: Extracts and constructs the 'Cookie' header string from the raw 'set-cookie' headers in an HTTP response.

methods.name: buildAuthHeaders
methods.description: Builds an authorization header object with the provided token and cookie.
